## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why is this feature needed?

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Mockup / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, links, or references to similar implementations.

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or information that may be useful.
